fullText.simplified:
第十六章、又消失三个人

    季平说三十三号房这出戏要继续唱下去。孙林兴奋极了，他准备大干一场。
    “我接下来要怎么做？”孙林兴致勃勃地问道，他恨不得现在就行动。
    “你……”季平斟酌了一下，然后接着说道：“我已经知道王克在哪儿了，有人告诉我最近在一个赌场见过他，大概又去赌博了。还有那个失踪的女明星，也有了线索。他们现在都不在西京市，你去跑一趟，找到他们，把你的那些推测跟当事人证实一下。”季平说完，递给孙林两张小纸条，上面写着两个地址。
    “啊？查……查他们？我……我以为我们现在最重要的事是对付梅望止和柳也惠那两个卑鄙小人呢。”孙林有点儿失望。他没想到在这关键时刻，他要离开西京市。
    “对付梅望止和柳也惠需要时间，不着急，我们一件一件来。”季平安慰着说道。
    “好吧。”孙林把纸条装进了衣服口袋里，起身准备走了。
    “对了，我让你做的那两件事，你做了吗？”就在孙林要离开办公室时，季平问了最后一个问题。
    “嗯，当然。三十三号房的信箱现在是坏的，另外钢笔我也拿到了。”孙林说完，指了指自己胸前口袋里的钢笔。
    季平满意地点点头，又叮嘱了孙林几句，才让他离开了。

    等孙林再回到西京市，已经是四天以后了，这是他和季平约定好的时间。孙林疲惫极了，恨不得躺在自家床上睡上一整天。就在这时，电视上的新闻让他睡意全无。新闻上说，丝绸花园的三十三号魔屋再次“吃”人，而且这次更加严重，消失了三个人：梅三三，柳雪迟，还有本市记者孙林。
    什么？我自己？我在三十三号房里消失了？孙林一下子从床上坐了起来，他的脑子里满是疑惑。他盯着电视上的新闻，竖起耳朵听着新闻报道中的每一个字：
    梅三三，十七岁，西京中学学生。平时五点半准时回家，但前天直到晚上八点仍没有回去。梅家人去学校找过，老师说她下午三点就请假离开了学校。
    柳雪迟，十五岁，立南中学学生。他告诉家人放学后要和朋友去看电影，但是至今还没回家。柳家人去问柳雪迟的朋友，结果那个朋友根本不知道要看电影的事，而且说当天一天都没见过柳雪迟。
    孙林，本市记者。近期为了调查三十三号房，一个人住在里面。周围的邻居被采访时，都表示和孙林说过话，但是最近两天没有见过他。孙林的同事也说他最近几天没去上班。
fullText.traditional:
第十六章、又消失三個人

    季平說三十三號房這齣戲要繼續唱下去。孫林興奮極了，他準備大幹一場。
    “我接下來要怎麼做？”孫林興致勃勃地問道，他恨不得現在就行動。
    “你……”季平斟酌了一下，然後接著說道：“我已經知道王克在哪兒了，有人告訴我最近在一個賭場見過他，大概又去賭博了。還有那個失蹤的女明星，也有了線索。他們現在都不在西京市，你去跑一趟，找到他們，把你的那些推測跟當事人證實一下。”季平說完，遞給孫林兩張小紙條，上面寫著兩個地址。
    “啊？查……查他們？我……我以為我們現在最重要的事是對付梅望止和柳也惠那兩個卑鄙小人呢。”孫林有點兒失望。他沒想到在這關鍵時刻，他要離開西京市。
    “對付梅望止和柳也惠需要時間，不著急，我們一件一件來。”季平安慰著說道。
    “好吧。”孫林把紙條裝進了衣服口袋裡，起身準備走了。
    “對了，我讓你做的那兩件事，你做了嗎？”就在孫林要離開辦公室時，季平問了最後一個問題。
    “嗯，當然。三十三號房的信箱現在是壞的，另外鋼筆我也拿到了。”孫林說完，指了指自己胸前口袋裡的鋼筆。
    季平滿意地點點頭，又叮囑了孫林幾句，才讓他離開了。

    等孫林再回到西京市，已經是四天以後了，這是他和季平約定好的時間。孫林疲憊極了，恨不得躺在自家床上睡上一整天。就在這時，電視上的新聞讓他睡意全無。新聞上說，絲綢花園的三十三號魔屋再次“吃”人，而且這次更加嚴重，消失了三個人：梅三三，柳雪遲，還有本市記者孫林。
    什麼？我自己？我在三十三號房裡消失了？孫林一下子從床上坐了起來，他的腦子裡滿是疑惑。他盯著電視上的新聞，豎起耳朵聽著新聞報道中的每一個字：
    梅三三，十七歲，西京中學學生。平時五點半準時回家，但前天直到晚上八點仍沒有回去。梅家人去學校找過，老師說她下午三點就請假離開了學校。
    柳雪遲，十五歲，立南中學學生。他告訴家人放學後要和朋友去看電影，但是至今還沒回家。柳家人去問柳雪遲的朋友，結果那個朋友根本不知道要看電影的事，而且說當天一天都沒見過柳雪遲。
    孫林，本市記者。近期為了調查三十三號房，一個人住在裡面。周圍的鄰居被採訪時，都表示和孫林說過話，但是最近兩天沒有見過他。孫林的同事也說他最近幾天沒去上班。

sentences.simplified: 柳家人去问柳雪迟的朋友，结果那个朋友根本不知道要看电影的事，
sentences.traditional: 柳家人去問柳雪遲的朋友，結果那個朋友根本不知道要看電影的事，
sentences.pinyin: liǔ jiā rén qù wèn liǔ xuě chí de péng you jié guǒ nà ge péng you gēn běn bù zhī dào yào kàn diàn yǐng de shì
sentences.english: The Liu family went to ask Liu Xuechi’s friend, but that friend didn’t know anything about going to the movies, ..

sentences.simplified: 而且说当天一天都没见过柳雪迟。
sentences.traditional: 而且說當天一天都沒見過柳雪遲。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě shuō dàng tiān yì tiān dōu méi jiàn guò liǔ xuě chí
sentences.english: .. and said that they hadn’t seen Liu Xuechi all day.

sentences.simplified: 孙林，本市记者。近期为了调查三十三号房，一个人住在里面。
sentences.traditional: 孫林，本市記者。近期為了調查三十三號房，一個人住在裡面。
sentences.pinyin: sūn lín běn shì jì zhě jìn qī wèi le diào chá sān shí sān hào fáng yí ge rén zhù zài lǐ miàn
sentences.english: Sun Lin, local reporter. Recently, in order to investigate the house at number thirty-three, he had been living there alone.

sentences.simplified: 周围的邻居被采访时，都表示和孙林说过话，但是最近两天没有见过他。
sentences.traditional: 周圍的鄰居被採訪時，都表示和孫林說過話，但是最近兩天沒有見過他。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu wéi de lín jū bèi cǎi fǎng shí dōu biǎo shì hé sūn lín shuō guò huà dàn shì zuì jìn liǎng tiān méi yǒu jiàn guò tā
sentences.english: When interviewed, the surrounding neighbors all said they had spoken with Sun Lin previously, but they hadn’t seen him in the past two days.

sentences.simplified: 孙林的同事也说他最近几天没去上班。
sentences.traditional: 孫林的同事也說他最近幾天沒去上班。
sentences.pinyin: sūn lín de tóng shì yě shuō tā zuì jìn jǐ tiān méi qù shàng bān
sentences.english: Sun Lin’s colleagues also said that he hadn’t been to work in the past few days.

sentence_translations: Chapter 16: Three More People Disappear
Ji Ping said that the opera relating to the house at number thirty-three must continue.
Sun Lin was extremely excited and was ready to make an all-out effort.
“What should I do next?” Sun Lin asked eagerly. He couldn’t wait to take action straight away.
“You …” Ji Ping pondered for a moment, then continued.
“I already know where Wang Ke is. Someone told me they had seen him recently at a casino. He’s probably gambling again.
There are also clues about the missing female celebrity.
None of them are in Xijing now. You should take a trip, find them, and verify your speculations with the people involved.”
After Ji Ping finished speaking, he handed Sun Lin two small slips of paper, on which were written two addresses.
“Ah …! Investigate … investigate them?
I … I thought the most important thing for us right now is to deal with those two despicable villains, Mei Wangzhi and Liu Yehui.”
Sun Lin was a bit disappointed. He hadn’t expected that at this critical moment, he would have to leave Xijing.
“Dealing with Mei Wangzhi and Liu Yehui will take time. Don’t rush, we’ll take it one thing at a time,” said Ji Ping, comforting him.
“Alright.” Sun Lin put the slips of paper into his pocket and got up to leave.
“By the way, those two things I asked you to do, have you done them?”
Just as Sun Lin was about to leave the office, Ji Ping asked one last question.
“Yeah, of course. The mailbox for the house at number thirty-three is broken now, and I also got the fountain pen.”
After Sun Lin finished speaking, he pointed to the fountain pen in his chest pocket.
Ji Ping nodded in satisfaction and gave Sun Lin a few more instructions before letting him leave.
By the time Sun Lin returned to Xijing, it was already four days later, which was the time he had agreed upon with Ji Ping.
Sun Lin was exhausted. He really wanted to lie down in his own bed and sleep for an entire day.
Just then, the news on the television made him wide awake.
The news reported that the cursed house at number thirty-three in Silk Garden had “eaten” people again, ..
.. and this time it was even more serious, with three people disappearing: Mei Sansan, Liu Xuechi, and the local journalist Sun Lin.
What? Me? I disappeared from the house at number thirty-three? Sun Lin suddenly sat up from the bed, his mind full of confusion.
He stared at the news on the television, straining his ears to catch every word of the report:
Mei Sansan, seventeen years old, a student at Xijing Middle School.
She usually returns home punctually at five thirty, ..
.. but the day before yesterday, she still hadn’t returned home by eight o’clock in the evening.
The Mei family went to the school to inquire, ..
.. and the teacher said that she had taken leave and left school at three o’clock in the afternoon.
Liu Xuechi, fifteen years old, a student at Li’nan Middle School.
He told his family that he was going to watch a movie with his friend after school, but he still hadn’t come home.
The Liu family went to ask Liu Xuechi’s friend, but that friend didn’t know anything about going to the movies, ..
.. and said that they hadn’t seen Liu Xuechi all day.
Sun Lin, local reporter. Recently, in order to investigate the house at number thirty-three, he had been living there alone.
When interviewed, the surrounding neighbors all said they had spoken with Sun Lin previously, but they hadn’t seen him in the past two days.
Sun Lin’s colleagues also said that he hadn’t been to work in the past few days.
